##### **Integration meets Innovation**

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we're on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

Celigo is looking for a **Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero** to own the highest-leverage program in the company: running Celigo on Celigo. When GTO operates on our own platform across GTM, CX, and G&A systems, we become our own best customer. We discover what's hard before customers find it, feed it directly into Product, and give Sales a credible, live reference in every deal. This role is the dedicated owner of that program, end-to-end.

##### **What would you do if hired?**

* Own the Customer Zero program as a funded initiative with a real roadmap, clear outcomes, and an operating rhythm that holds across competing priorities. You set the pace, define what done looks like, and keep the work alive without needing someone to push it. You measure yourself by business value delivered, not by meetings held.

Surface what's genuinely hard, prioritize it, and shepherd it into Product's roadmap in partnership with the CPO's org.

* Weigh user needs against security, privacy, and governance considerations (RBAC, permissions, service accounts), making trade-offs deliberately rather than after the fact. Build the prescriptive playbook Product and Sales need: governance patterns, reference architectures, and proof points that hold up in enterprise conversations.
* Be the external face of how Celigo runs on Celigo. Present at flagship events, join key customer and prospect conversations, and package our internal use into references Sales can put in front of prospects and existing customers. Enable Product Marketing and Sales to scale the story beyond you.

------------------

The People Product team builds the internal tools and frameworks that power every employee's journey across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt. We combine a hybrid "build + buy" approach to deliver intelligent, scalable and people-centric experiences across hiring, compensation, onboarding, learning, performance and more — connecting our mission to empower local economies with the experience of the people who make it happen. We partner closely with Design, Engineering, Analytics, People/HR, Total Rewards and Talent Acquisition to build products that elevate the entire People Tech stack across all three brands.

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the our internal compensation products — this includes the tooling, data, and AI that determine how DoorDash sets and maintains pay ranges across every job family, level, and country.

Range setting is the starting point, as it is the core process of a compensation team and the infrastructure everything else is built on. Your role is to turn that into a product: a range-setting workspace that ingests market and internal data to enable a Compensation Partner to review and make decisions.

This is an individual contributor role with a clearly scoped product area. The range-setting tool and the monitoring dashboard are the anchor. You will also own the seams into adjacent compensation surfaces — recruiter offer guidance, budget modeling, headcount planning, and Workday range loads — wherever they depend on range data.

jobs.desc:
**Who We Are**

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

#### **The Role**

We're hiring a Product Manager to own the roadmap for the Observability and Compute/Network teams within Addepar's Foundation Engineering organization. This is a foundational infrastructure role: you'll define and drive the roadmap for how engineers understand the health of their systems (metrics, logs, tracing, alerting, on-call tooling, SLOs) and for the compute and networking substrate their services run on (provisioning, container orchestration, networking, security posture, capacity planning, and cost).

You'll work closely with the rest of the Foundation Engineering group to translate reliability risk, infrastructure constraints, and platform strategy into a prioritized, outcome-driven roadmap. This role reports to product leadership within Developer Platform and partners day to day with engineering leadership for Observability and Compute/Network.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Own and evolve the product roadmap for the Observability and Compute/Network teams, spanning metrics/logging/tracing platforms, alerting and on-call tooling, SLO and error-budget frameworks, dashboards, compute provisioning, container orchestration, networking, service mesh, capacity planning, and infrastructure cost management.
* Partner with engineering leads across Foundation Engineering to balance reliability and security risks, developer needs, capacity constraints, and cost, translating those tradeoffs into clearly scoped and sequenced investments.
* Define and track outcomes across reliability, performance, developer experience, and cost—for example, SLO attainment, time to detect and restore service, self-service adoption, provisioning lead time, and infrastructure cost per unit—and use them to prioritize investment.
* Drive the self-service agenda: make instrumentation, dashboards, and compute/network provisioning available through paved paths that are secure and policy-compliant by default, so teams get visibility and capacity without manual tickets or one-off configurations.
* Partner with the Information Security and Risk (ISR) team to translate security requirements and risk findings into roadmap priorities, including secure defaults, access controls, auditability, and risk-based vulnerability remediation across observability and compute/network platforms.
* Gather and synthesize feedback from engineering teams across the organization (via incident retrospectives, on-call surveys, and direct engagement) to identify visibility and infrastructure gaps and translate them into roadmap priorities.
* Represent the Observability and Compute/Network teams' roadmaps to platform leadership, product stakeholders, and cross-functional partners; communicate tradeoffs, sequencing, and progress clearly.
* Monitor industry trends in observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog) and compute/network infrastructure (Kubernetes, service mesh, cloud networking, cost optimization) to inform build-vs-buy

**About Foodsmart**:

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

  

**About the Role:**

Reporting to our Chief Product Officer, this Senior Product Manager will be responsible for driving Foodsmart’s member activation. Every outcome we deliver for our members and clients starts with that first visit. You will own the funnel from first outreach to first visit, including the messaging, the channels, and the incentive structure that motivate members to show up.

Your customers are our members and our clients, who depend on us to turn eligible lives into engaged ones. You’ll lead a cross-functional pod to build out the systems and capabilities to achieve this goal and will work closely with Marketing, Data, and Partnerships to find what moves members from “eligible” to “booked” to “showed up,” and to do it at a cost that scales. This role is ideal for a product manager who is as comfortable in a funnel dashboard and an experiment readout as they are in the details of a text-message delivery issue or a broken scheduling flow.

*Lead the Activation Pod & Funnel*

* Run a disciplined experimentation program: clear hypotheses, fast readouts, and confident rollouts

*Drive the incentive structure*

We are hiring a Senior Product Owner / Senior Product Manager who can run a product lane with minimal oversight. This is not an entry point into product management. You'll take ownership of scope, prioritize and sequence work, and make sound decisions independently without needing frequent escalation. You should already be comfortable operating in Scrum/Kanban-style agile environments and in fixed-scope/waterfall, contract-driven delivery, and know how to shift between the two depending on what the work requires. Imedview is a claims and litigation service partner specializing in Liability, Workers’ Compensation, and No-Fault/PIP Claims. Our expertise allows us to proudly service both legal and insurance professionals, nationally. With more than 20 years of experience and a passion for delivering outstanding customer service and building lasting client relationships, we’re growing fast — and we’re always on the lookout for exceptional individuals to join our dynamic, expanding family. Ready to be part of something groundbreaking? Come grow with us!

Employees residing within 100 miles of the office will be expected to attend monthly in-person meetings.

To meet increasing client demand, we are deepening our investment in product and engineering. We’re wrapping up the rewrite of our core internal software and we’re looking to finish strong before moving into the next chapter of continued development.

jobs.desc:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

**What you will be doing:**
---------------------------

Beacon Biosignals is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the roadmap and day-to-day product decisions for our clinician- and site-facing web application, the primary way clinicians, clinical research sites, and trial teams interact with Beacon's machine-learning-enabled brain health platform. This role reports to the Manager, Web Applications.

In this role, you'll work within Beacon's Web Apps team to drive major development milestones for the next generation of Beacon's web applications for clinicians and clinical sites. You'll shape product direction in partnership with the team's manager and turn it into quarterly plans your team can execute against. You'll be a clear, credible voice for the product with external users and internal stakeholders such as Beacon's clinical, scientific, regulatory, and commercial teams.

This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates based near Beacon HQ in Boston, or another Beacon hub (e.g., New York City).

**What success looks like:**
----------------------------

* Build deep knowledge of clinicians, sleep technicians, site coordinators, investigators, and sponsor teams, and use it to ensure the roadmap reflects their real needs and Beacon's business goals.
* Own a single product that serves both diagnostic and clinical trial workflows, identifying where needs overlap and diverge, and make clear, well-reasoned, documented decisions about shared versus specialized functionality.
* Ensure the web experience is coherent with the wider ecosystem it depends on, including devices, data pipelines, ML models, and other software products. * Work closely with software engineers, product designers, and data science and machine-learning teams to align on technical specifications and feasibility, and on how model outputs are presented to users.
* Practice continuous discovery, running formal and informal usability tests and user interviews early and often, with particular attention to the workflows of busy clinicians and site staff.
* Deliver product requirements and changes through formal design controls in a regulated environment, using contemporary tools (at Beacon, we use Ketryx!).
* Balance the needs of multiple customer types and internal stakeholders, including clinical operations, regulatory and quality, and commercial teams, and manage external client-facing demos that showcase the product's current capabilities and roadmap.
* Communicate project progress, decision-making tradeoffs, and risks with key stakeholders effectively, often, and efficiently.

* Bachelor's Degree in business, engineering, or a related field; or equivalent experience.

Compensation decisions are based on various factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, certifications, location, and business needs. Employees may be eligible for additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance, paid holidays and PTO; and professional development opportunities and tools.

  

**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

**The Mission**
---------------

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.

In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.

This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Platform Vision:** Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.
* **Unified Entitlements:** Build the entitlements model that determines what every customer can access within Konnect. Make entitlements a first-class concept that is consistently defined in contracts, enforced in-product, honored by provisioning, and reflected in billing.
* **Pricing & Packaging Delivery:** Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.
* **Metering & Usage Visibility:** Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.
* **Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle:** Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.
* **Enterprise & Marketplace Motions:** Connect Kong's enterprise sales and channel

**About DealerOn**

We are an online marketing company providing website and agency services to automotive dealerships across North and South America. We are known for our cutting-edge products that streamline the car buying process and provide an experience both shoppers and dealers love. Our business model is working: we were recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest growing companies six years in a row, expanding to over 30 manufacturer relationship, and over 5,000 dealer partners. We are proud of what our company has done, and it’s all due to the talented and diverse team we’ve been lucky enough to assemble.

We are seeking a customer-focused, data-driven Senior Product Manager to shape product direction and lead high-impact SaaS initiatives that deliver measurable value for dealerships, their consumers, and our business.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned, technically grounded product manager who balances customer needs, technical feasibility, and business priorities, and who uses AI as a core part of how they work every day. They prototype to validate ideas while collaborating with UX and engineering teams, have sound judgment about where AI belongs in the product, and help peers build the same fluency.

**What You’ll Do**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Partner with Product leadership to shape the roadmap around company goals and customer needs.

* Facilitate backlog refinement, release planning, and release readiness.

* Drive launches through validation, stakeholder communication, enablement, and post-release analysis.

**Customer Discovery**

* Collaborate with UX team for product discovery through customer interviews, workflow analysis, usability testing, and feedback synthesis.
* Build deep knowledge of dealership operations, automotive retail workflows, digital marketing, and agency workflows.
* Translate qualitative and quantitative research into unmet needs, workflow improvements, and scalable product opportunities.

* Earning trust across Product, Engineering, UX, and operational teams.
* Making decisions that reflect strong customer empathy and measurable business impact.
* Shortening the path from idea to validated concept by using AI tools to test with stakeholders early.

**The Mission**
===============

*“Leading healthcare into the agentic era.”*

Every day, patients call their clinic to schedule an appointment, ask a question, or request a prescription refill. Behind each conversation is a busy healthcare team coordinating people, information, and systems.

Taxo builds Voice AI agents that take on this administrative work. Our agents connect with EHR and practice management systems to help teams handle patient intake, complex scheduling, and refill requests, with reliable workflows and clear handoffs to people.

=========================================================

As our Senior Product Manager, you’ll bring deep clinical and EHR knowledge into the decisions that shape Taxo. You’ll understand how care teams actually work, identify where automation can help, and turn that insight into products engineers can build and customers can use. This role is for someone who can move comfortably between a clinical workflow, an EHR integration, and a product decision.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* **Get Close to the Workflow:** Spend time with clinicians, practice teams, and healthcare operators to understand their workflows, bottlenecks, and exceptions.
* **Own Product Decisions:** Own product discovery, roadmap priorities, requirements, and acceptance criteria for AI-powered administrative workflows.

===============

* **The Product Builder:** Experience delivering healthcare software from discovery through adoption, with concrete examples of workflow exceptions you addressed, integration tradeoffs you made, and measurable adoption or operational outcomes.
* **The Translator:** The ability to map complex workflows, identify exceptions, and explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical colleagues.
* **The Systems Thinker:** Practical understanding of EHR capabilities, integration constraints, data quality, and patient privacy, grounded in product decisions you have made.
* **The Decision Maker:** Strong prioritization and analytical skills, with a track record of using customer feedback and product data to make decisions.
* **The Owner:** Comfort working closely with engineers and taking ownership of the details needed to get a product into use.
* **Bonus:** A clinical, clinical informatics, or healthcare operations background; hands-on EHR implementation or integration experience; familiarity with HL7/FHIR, conversational AI, or workflow automation.

**Why Taxo**
============

Healthcare teams should be able to spend more time on patients and less time on administration. Help us build the products and company that make that possible.

* **AI with a Clear Purpose:** Focus on where automation can reduce work while preserving reliability and human oversight.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Reporting & Analytics
jobs.desc:
**About RocketRez:**  
RocketRez is the revenue maximization platform behind boat tours, theme parks, zoos, and other attractions and experience operators. Operators run their businesses on us: ticketing, capacity, memberships, point of sale, web stores, and the data that tells them how how to grow their business.
  
  
**The role:**  
Operators ask us questions every day. How did yesterday go? Which channel actually converts? Did the new pricing pay off, or did it just move demand around? Your job is to turn those questions into data, reports, and visuals that answer them clearly and lead to a revenue maximizing decision.
  
**You'll own Reporting & Analytics end to end:** the reports, dashboards, and insights operators use to run their business, from the general manager checking yesterday's attendance to the finance lead reconciling a month of revenue across channels, and the data models and metric definitions behind them. You'll own its roadmap, its customers, and the case for where engineering time goes. Your job is to prove that reporting can be the front door to RocketRez: where operators start their day, and what moves them to act. You'll be measured on usage, and on the revenue operators earn from the decisions reporting drives.
  
  
**What we're building:**  
Operators move more of their business onto RocketRez when they trust us with their busiest day, and that trust depends on the numbers. If the reporting is wrong, late, or confusing, nothing else we build gets believed.
  
First, reporting operators trust. Core reporting on par with the best in hospitality.
  
Next, a revenue engine. Operators set revenue targets and campaigns, track their pace against them and against past seasons, and get clear options when they fall behind.
  
Then, automated revenue management. Automation keeps tracking and planning running without the operator asking. It recommends actions grounded in the operator's own history and in how similar operators are performing, and makes acting on them a single click. Season pass sales dipping? Here are three options based on this season and the last two.
  
  
**What you'll do:**  
Understand the question• Spend real time with operators across roles, from general managers and finance leads to marketers and front-gate supervisors. Learn the decisions they make and the questions they need answered to make them.
  

* Design reporting that leads to a decision. Every report should make clear what it means and what to do next.

Data fluency• Prototype with real data. Write your own SQL to mock up a report or metric and put it in front of operators before engineering builds it.
  

* Own the metric definitions the platform runs on: revenue, attendance, capacity utilization, and conversion mean the same thing in every report, in every domain.
* Apply statistical judgment: seasonality, small samples, cohorts, fair comparisons, and forecasting.
* Choose the right visual for the question, and hold a high bar for clarity, accuracy, and honest scales.
* Treat data quality as product quality.
* Work with other domains so new products capture the data reporting needs before they ship.

**Strategy and roadmap• Own the roadmap:** sizing, sequencing, and what gets cut.
  

* Shape how automation and AI turn insights into recommended actions: which recommendations are trustworthy, when a human should decide, and the guardrails around both.
* Define how cross-operator benchmarks work: peer sets, minimum sample sizes, and anonymization that operators trust enough to opt into.
* Make the build, buy, and partner calls on analytics tooling, and know the market well enough to say which gaps are worth closing.

**What we look for:**  
The trait we care about most is adaptability. The tools and methods of product management are changing, so we hire people who have already reinvented how they work on their own initiative and will do it again.
  

* You've rebuilt how you work without being told to, including becoming AI-na

IntegriChain is the data and application backbone for market access departments of Life Sciences manufacturers. We deliver the data, the applications, and the business process infrastructure for patient access and therapy commercialization. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.

We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in: Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.

We are excited to offer a hybrid working environment for our employees. To be successful in this role, there are some requirements to visit our office locations from quarterly to a few times a quarter for workshops, team meetings and collaboration between teams. There will be opportunity for international travel annually or as needed based on business needs.

 **Job Description**

**Mission**

IntegriChain is on a mission to help all stakeholders in the life sciences industry drive access. We do this through our relentless focus on unifying all of the critical business functions for therapy commercialization and access contracts and pricing, gross-to-net, channel, and patient services unlocking strategic payer, provider, pharmacy and patient access insights for our life sciences customers.

This role is for a **Sr. Product Manager who wants real ownership and real impact**. You will own a critical product area end‑to‑end—**from problem discovery through delivery and adoption**—with clear accountability for outcomes, not just execution. You’ll operate as a decision‑maker at the center of Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and customer‑facing teams, shaping strategy while staying deeply connected to how the product is built and used.

The problems you’ll work on are **complex, operationally critical, and deeply embedded in customer workflows**. Success requires strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to translate messy, real‑world processes into clear product direction. You’ll be expected to challenge assumptions, prioritize based on evidence, and make hard tradeoffs when constraints collide.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

This is not a role for someone who waits for direction or optimizes for consensus. It *is* a role for a PM who:

* Wants **clear ownership** of a product area
* Is energized by **hard problems with meaningful business impact**
* Can balance **long‑term strategy with hands‑on execution**
* Earns trust by making sound decisions and delivering results

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Skills**

* Own and evolve the multi-quarter product strategy and roadmap (6+ quarters) for assigned product areas, aligned to company objectives and market needs.
* Facilitate prioritization with stakeholders using structured frameworks (e.g., value vs. effort, risk reduction, strategic alignment).
* Lead discovery activities with customers, internal users, and domain experts to validate problems before solutions.
* Translate validated needs into epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria and business context to explain the business need and value.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, dependencies, and scope changes, and drive resolution.
* Lead release planning and readiness for assigned product

At Accelerate Learning, we’re dedicated to engaging and inspiring STEM education for PreK-12. Our mission is to spark curiosity in the STEM classroom with programs designed by experienced teachers and STEM experts. Supporting over 9 million students and 750,000 teachers, we constantly adapt to educators’ needs and customer feedback to promote powerful teaching strategies that shape the future of STEM learning.
  
  
“For teachers, by teachers” is not a slogan—it’s a fact. Our award-winning product, STEMscopes, was incubated in the classroom and developed by over 200 teachers, science experts, and science professors.  
  
We’re scaling rapidly and investing in cutting-edge cloud technologies, AI, and modern software practices to bring STEM education into the future. Join us, and your work will directly shape how millions of students learn.  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY**  
  
At Accelerate Learning, we’re on a mission to transform STEM education for millions of students and teachers. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who thrives on curiosity, customer obsession, and strategic thinking — someone who doesn’t just follow a roadmap but helps shape it.

Key responsibilities include:

* Shape and refine the product roadmap in alignment with business goals and educational outcomes.

* Communicate product vision and progress effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Explore new technologies and approaches (AI, event-driven systems, adaptive learning) to keep products competitive.

* Hands-on experience working in Agile/Scrum environments — writing user stories, managing backlogs, and leading sprint rituals.
* Strong skills in gathering requirements, translating them into epics and stories, and prioritizing work for development teams.

* Passion for improving education and empathy for teachers and learners.
* Curiosity to explore instructional challenges and design products that enhance student engagement and learning outcomes.
* Bonus: A love of STEM.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Alianza's Intelligent Communications Fabric gives service providers a path to modernize voice networks and deliver AI-infused experiences on top of them. Both depend on the same underlying capability: making a live carrier network safely programmable, whether the change is initiated by an operator managing thousands of subscribers or by an external partner building a new experience.

This role owns that capability. It covers the configuration and change orchestration tooling operators use to extract, manipulate, and update their environments at scale, and the API surface that lets Experience Providers build on the platform. The two are the same problem at different distances from the network, and this role holds the point of view across both.

The person in this role will bring structure and a well-informed position to a space where much of it does not exist yet, working in close partnership with engineering, legal, and the commercial team.

Key Responsibilities

Configuration and Change Orchestration (near-term focus)

* Own the go-forward product strategy for Alianza's configuration and change orchestration toolset, shaping how its capabilities are packaged and delivered within the platform.
* Translate a broad existing capability set into a prioritized roadmap driven by real Alianza customer use cases, distinguishing vendor-stated capability from Alianza-validated value at each step.
* Resolve overlap and sequencing questions with existing internal tooling that covers adjacent ground, particularly in professional services migrations and configuration extraction.
* Define how this tooling supports the broader platform story, including its role as an OSS/BSS change-velocity layer and any tactical bridging value while longer-term platform capabilities mature.
* Partner with commercial and Advantage program stakeholders on packaging and pricing.

Experience Provider API Surface

* Own the Experience Provider API surface: the integration contracts partners build against, the partner onboarding and lifecycle APIs, and new partner-facing APIs as the Experience Provider program expands.
* As the partner platform matures, lead the definition of the consent and authorization model for partner integrations, covering how end-user and account-level consent is captured, stored, and enforced when a third party operates on network data.
* Work with engineering to evaluate build, partner, and license options where existing or third-party capability can accelerate delivery of the partner API surface.

Cross-Functional and Organizational

* Partner closely with engineering leadership on technical feasibility and sequencing across both areas.
* Coordinate with legal on consent, data privacy, and IP questions.
* Contribute to and improve the frameworks the broader product team uses for partner enablement.
* Represent this portfolio in external partner and developer conversations.

Qualifications

Required

* 7+ years of product management experience, including meaningful time owning API-first or platform products.
* Experience taking an inherited or newly integrated product through a productization or build-vs-buy-vs-integrate decision.
* Demonstrated experience defining and shipping partner or developer-facing APIs.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building structure (roadmaps, frameworks, pipelines) where it does not yet exist.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with engineering, legal, and commercial teams.

Preferred

* Background in UCaaS, CPaaS, or other large-scale distributed cloud communications platforms.
* Experience with consent, privacy, or authorization and policy enforcement systems.
* Experience integrating a product following a merger or acquisition.
* Prior experience at a startup or scale-up building platform or partner-facing products.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Staff Product Manager**
=========================

**This is a remote position.**  
**JOB ID #**

Ad Hoc is a technology company that empowers organizations to deliver scalable, impactful digital services. Using modern, agile methods, our team creates products that meet people’s needs and transform their experience of government.

**Work on things that matter**

Our collaborations have shaped some of the defining moments in public-sector service delivery. We’ve helped build products that connect Veterans to tailored services, help millions access affordable health care, and support important programs like Head Start. As we work with agencies to deliver critical services, we’re also changing how the government approaches technology.

**Built for a remote life**

Our culture, communications, and tools are built for remote work, enabling us to bring together top talent nationwide. At Ad Hoc, remote life empowers our teams to design work environments that fit their lives and that foster flexibility and collaboration to achieve positive outcomes for our customers.

**Committed to high expectations and a welcoming culture**

Ad Hoc values acceptance, accountability, and humility. We aren’t heroes. We learn from our mistakes and improve the process for the next time. We build small, inclusive teams to collaborate closely with our partners to solve the right problems and deliver software that works.

The **Federal Civilian** business unit supports many customers spanning the federal, commercial, and nonprofit space. Our customers include NASA, the General Services Administration, Office of Personnel Management, the Library of Congress, Health & Human Services, and the FDIC. We partner with these agencies to build new capabilities, deliver products, establish data as a strategic asset for informed decision-making, modernize legacy systems, and build the digital service infrastructure necessary to scale their mission impact.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

The Staff Product Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for shaping product strategy, guiding product development, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes across complex digital services and technology initiatives.  
  
In this role, you will work closely with government customers, delivery teams, designers, engineers, researchers, and internal leadership to establish product priorities, define roadmaps, and help teams deliver solutions that meet user and organizational needs.  
  
As a trusted product leader, you will bring a strategic perspective while remaining connected to the day-to-day product work. You will have the autonomy to influence product direction, navigate complex challenges, and help multidisciplinary teams make informed decisions.  
  
This is an individual contributor position with no direct people management responsibilities. The role emphasizes product ownership, strategic collaboration, and stakeholder partnership rather than formal team management.  
  
**Primary expectations of a Staff Product Manager include:**

* Lead product strategy, vision, and roadmap development for complex digital products and services.
* Partner directly with government customers and stakeholders to understand business priorities, user needs, and desired outcomes.
* Translate customer objectives, research, data, and technical considerations into clear product priorities and actionable plans.
* Own and maintain product roadmaps, backlogs, requirements, and prioritization activities in partnership with delivery teams.
* Collaborate with engineering, design, research, and delivery teams to guide product development and support successful outcomes.
* Facilitate product discussions, planning sessions, roadmap reviews, and stakeholder engagements.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customer and internal stakeholders, providing product recommendations and communicating priorities and tradeoffs.
* Balance strategic product planning with hands-on involvem

Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie  
Intelligence Connected

**WoodMac.com**

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

**Job Description**

To support the development of our Lens data analytics platform, we are looking for a dynamic Senior Product Manager to be an integral part of our Commodities Product team covering Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals and Metals & Mining.

*Knowledge & experience*

* Experienced Product Manager, or Analyst looking to expand their role into the Product Management space
* Experience with the product development cycle including agile software development (Scrum/Kanban), design process, and instrumenting analytics.
* Basic industry knowledge and strong interest on one or multiple sectors covered in our portfolio (Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals, Metals & Mining), understanding of the major players, market conditions, and industry standards. Intellectual curiosity for industry is a must.
* Experience working on data migrations projects, and using AI in product development is a strong plus.
* Good oral and written communication skills
* Key tools that we use are JIRA, Productboard and Amplitude. Our tech stack is mainly on AWS and Snowflake.

*Impact on the team*

* Act as the day-to-day point person for the cross-functional team, providing a seamless bridge between Research Analysts, Data teams, UX, and Engineering to identify solutions that work within a set of defined constraints and align to the broader business strategy and achieve customer-focused results.
* Align understanding by defining user requirements with clear acceptance criteria across multiple features
* Assist in documentation and testing of given solutions to ensure fit for customers
* Collaborate with the Senior Product Manager to help communicate product value and priorities to internal teams, including sales and marketing
Foster healthy culture, support and collaboration for a distributed team  

*Stakeholder & client relationships*

* Translate requirements from customers and defining the product functionality according to wider customer needs
* Inform senior stakeholders on progress and raise risks to the appropriate level
* Engage frequently with users to gather feedback from relevant customers and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Sales to enable go-to-market effort

**Equal Opportunities**

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Seven Starling is revolutionizing women's behavioral health through our clinically-validated virtual care platform. As a venture-backed, rapidly scaling startup at the forefront of maternal healthcare innovation, we've developed a groundbreaking clinical model that combines specialized therapy, peer support, and medication management to effectively treat perinatal mood disorders. Our approach delivers exceptional results — 90% of patients experience clinically significant symptom improvement.

We've established strategic partnerships with leading health plans including UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Aetna, plus a growing network of OBGYN clinics nationwide, positioning us for accelerated growth in the $50B+ women's behavioral health market.

### **About the role**

We’re hiring for a **Senior Product Manager** — a strategic, execution-minded builder who will be a core member of our Product team. This is a high-impact role reporting directly to the VP of Product and partnering closely with the engineering team and cross-functional roles to design and scale the systems and experiences that power our precision mental health care model.

The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience in product management and thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. We're looking for a mission-driven and resourceful self-starter who excels at turning complex problems into clear, scalable solutions. You should be a strong communicator, deeply curious about user needs, and comfortable experimenting with AI tools to build systems and documentation from the ground up. Experience in digital health and early stage startup environments is strongly preferred.

If you're an experienced product professional with a strong commitment to our mission, we want to hear from you. Join us in paving the way for expanded access to high-quality women's mental healthcare!

### **What you'll do**

* **Own our end-to-end product development process**, from user research and scoping to execution, QA, and post-launch measurement and iteration
* **Conduct deep user research** with patients, clinicians, referring providers, and internal team members to understand their pain points and needs
* **Develop clear, actionable PRDs and prototypes** to define product specs and workflows that meet the needs of cross-functional stakeholders and set clear objectives for the engineering team to execute on
* **Lead product launches,** partnering closely with engineering, operations, and clinical leads on training, documentation, and process updates to ensure seamless rollout and adoption of new products and tools

* **Own the tools that run our patient journey,** from third-party survey and communication platforms, to EHR templates and the automations tied to scheduling, screening, and care coordination

* **Use AI tools** to accelerate your own work and continuously innovate on how we build as a team, from research and documentation to prototyping and design

* **Define and monitor success metrics** for core tools and services that we build, including data analysis, dashboard creation, and company-wide impact reporting

* **Partner with our VP of Product and other senior leaders** to inform roadmap planning and strategic prioritization

### **Who you are**

* You are a **senior-level individual contributor (IC)** with 5+ years of experience in product management, ideally with a significant portion of that time in digital health
* You have a track record of **owning complex, cross-functional products** from problem definition to launch
* You’re comfortable with **ambiguous, early-stage environments**, and excited to be a part of a small team developing product strategy, process, and tools
* You’re both **empathetic and systems-oriented** — equally energized by speaking with users and by designing scalable, backend workflows

* You actively **use AI tools to move faster** — you’ve used agentic tools to actually build or prototype, not just ask questions

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
### **Who We Are**

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform and an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 400 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an equal-opportunity employer, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce. At Cobalt, we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations to continue to nurture our unique, rich, diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

**Description**

Modern software demands continuous security validation. Cobalt is pioneering the evolution beyond legacy, point-in-time PTaaS through our Autonomous and Continuous pentesting platform-providing continuous, scalable, and AI-driven security coverage across enterprise environments.

In the role of **Senior Technical Product Manager**, you will shape the strategic product vision, steer live initiatives, and spearhead 0-to-1 feature development to drive business ROI across Cobalt's Autonomous and Continuous Pentesting portfolio. You will conduct deep product discovery, instill scalable PM leadership practices, and redefine how continuous, autonomous offensive security is delivered to modern enterprises.

You will combine strong business acumen with technical rigor, driving clear feature ownership from discovery to delivery. Operating as a proactive cross-functional leader, you will challenge existing processes and communicate transparently to ensure our continuous pentesting platform solves critical customer security problems with measurable impact.

**What You Would Do**

As a member of a growing team of product managers your responsibilities include:

* **Strategic PM Leadership & Business ROI:** Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for the Autonomous and Continuous pentesting portfolio. Align feature scope directly with customer value and measurable business outcomes, tracking clear adoption and retention metrics.
* **Product Discovery Excellence:** Lead continuous customer discovery and market validation to identify high-impact customer problems in the continuous security testing space. Translate complex user needs into actionable, validated product requirements.
* **End-to-End Feature Ownership:** Take full operational ownership of product features across the entire lifecycle—from initial ideation and specification to execution, deployment, and post-launch evaluation.
* **Proactive Leadership & Process Innovation:** Actively challenge inefficient workflows, implement scalable product processes, and foster high alignment across engineering, design, marketing, and executive stakeholders.
* **Transparent & Structured Communication:** Maintain standard executive-level visibility into roadmap progress, product decisions, and operational metrics through regular updates and clear artifact documentation.
* **Domain Expertise in Autonomous Security:** Serve as the internal subject matter expert on continuous vulnerability management, AI-driven offensive security techniques, and automated pentesting workflows.
* **Data-Driven Performance Management:** Define and monitor rigorous success criteria, evaluating product performance against strategic business metrics and customer satisfaction outcomes.

### **About Us**

Think about your last hotel stay. Did you skip the front desk line with mobile check-in? Message the staff for extra pillows? Order a late-night snack with a tap on your phone? **Then you’ve likely run into Canary in the wild.**

Canary Technologies is the leading agentic AI platform for hotel and guest management, powering the digital infrastructure for more than 20,000 hotels in 125+ countries. The world's most renowned hospitality brands, including Marriott International, Four Seasons and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, partner with us to increase revenue, improve operations and elevate the guest experience.

We’ve executed the largest deployment of autonomous AI systems in hospitality, building technology that fundamentally redefines how guests and hotels interact. It’s made us one of the top-funded hotel technology companies in the world, with nearly **$200M raised to date.**

Canary has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 **Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, Inc. 5000 fastest-growing company,** and **swept the 2026 HotelTechAwards**, including *Best Place to Work, #1 Guest Experience Platform,* and *the Hotelier’s Choice Award*. We’re scaling our team to bring innovation to life faster than ever.

We're growing quickly, and we're looking for people who are passionate about their work, want to grow with us and are ready to take on more responsibility along the way. We value rigor and velocity in equal measure: high standards, fast pace, real ownership. If that's the environment you're looking for, this is the place for you.

**Come join us! Let’s shape the future of hospitality together.**

**About the Role**

We're looking for a **Director of Product** to own our flagship offering: the Digital Guest Journey. This role is pivotal in shaping the way travelers around the world interact with hotels in the digital age. As Director of Product, you'll own the roadmap, evolution, and success of the Digital Guest Journey — setting the vision, making the hard calls, and ensuring the product consistently exceeds the expectations of our top partners while delighting millions of travelers worldwide.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Own the product strategy and multi-year roadmap for the Digital Guest Journey — defining what gets built, what doesn't, and why.
* Proactively diagnose high-impact opportunities by synthesizing signals from customers, data, sales, and the competitive landscape.
* Maintain direct, ongoing relationships with hotel operators and enterprise clients to shorten feedback loops and sharpen prioritization between formal research cycles.
* Translate product decisions into business narratives connecting product metrics to company-level outcomes including revenue, margin, and churn.
* Lead technical conversations with engineering and enterprise clients with precision, including system architecture, integration dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Drive execution and alignment across engineering, sales, customer success, and design around shared outcomes.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 2–3 years in a senior or director-level PM role at an enterprise SaaS company.
* A track record of proactively identifying high-impact problems — not just executing on a roadmap handed to you.
* The ability to narrate a product decision in business terms: what metric moved, what it meant for revenue, margin, or retention, and how you knew it mattered.
* Technical depth to explain how your product works under the hood — not just what it does — and lead conversations with engineers and enterprise clients at the right level of detail.
* Examples of driving cross-functional alignment without organizational authority, and staying personally accountable through launch, onboarding, and early adoption.

### **Compensation**

*Total cash compensation ranges from $275,000-$350,000.*  
  
*This role also includes a stock option grant, subject to board approval.*

**About Tempo**

Tempo Communications builds the test, measurement, and tooling products that technicians rely on to install and maintain communications networks across copper, fiber, PoE, and underground utility location. Our brands are Tempo, Paladin Tools, and KingFisher.

We are an independent, closely held, owner-led company of roughly 130 people, headquartered in Vista, California, with operations in Wales, Hungary, and Australia. Our customer is the field technician, and our promise is straightforward: **Find it. Fix it. Prove it.**

**The Role**

We are hiring a Director of Product Management to own how Tempo decides what to build, in what order, and why. This is a working leadership role rather than a purely strategic one: you will carry a product category of your own while leading three product line managers across the rest of the portfolio, reporting directly to the CEO.

**This is a step up, and we mean it that way.** We expect to hire a senior product manager or product line leader who has outgrown their current scope and is ready to run a portfolio, rather than someone who has held a director title for a decade. If the seat above you does not exist where you are, this is that seat.

*This is hands-on work at a company small enough that your decisions ship. If you are looking for a comfortable landing, this is not it. If you want a portfolio of your own, real financial discipline behind the choices, and products you defined in technicians' hands inside of eighteen months, read on.*

**What You'll Own**

**Application knowledge.** Everything else in this role depends on it. Innovative products come from understanding how the work actually gets done and then recognizing where safety, productivity, or quality can be improved. You will need to understand the workflow of a locate, a splice, a certification, and a pull. That knowledge either arrives with you from the field or you build it deliberately through voice-of-customer work and ride-alongs with end users, and you will hold your team to the same standard.

**The portfolio.** Location & Markers, Fiber Test & Measurement, Copper & PoE, and Tools. You will build and defend a multi-year roadmap with genuine continuity of technology behind it rather than a list of individually funded projects, and you will carry one category yourself, P&L included.

**The funnel, with financial rigor.** You will build the business cases, rank the funnel on financial merit, and answer for that ranking. Projects will be funded and killed on your analysis, and we expect you to tell us when something should stop.

**Stage gate discipline.** You will own our NP&SI stage-gate process end to end: deliverables defined for each gate, evidence presented at the gate, and a vote that can genuinely fail.

**Market sizing and competitive intelligence.** The quantitative half of understanding your market. You will size an opportunity before recommending that we invest in it, and you will defend the assumptions when someone pushes back on them.

**Launch outcomes.** Today we track launch dates, but not what the launches actually earned. You will own revenue, margin, and vitality index measured against plan and reported on a cadence. Application notes, training materials, and sales tools are product deliverables as well, and you own that they exist and that a representative can sell from them, even when someone else delivers the training.

**The team.** Three product line managers. You will set development plans, run structured reviews, coach on business case construction and market analysis, and build a deeper bench than the one you inherit.

**What You'll Bring**

**Required**

* Eight or more years in product management or product line management for physical products, such as instruments, test and measurement equipment, electrical or electronic hardware, or professional tools.
* Application depth in how field work actually gets done, whether you earned it in the field or built it deliberately thro

**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

***Who*** **We're Looking For:**

We are looking for a Director of Product Management to lead a team of PMs as well as own the product strategy for empowering developers on the Now platform to build and take their applications to production faster. These areas include developer reach, testing, sandboxing, metering, and deployment of AI and human generated code.

As agentic build tools compress the time it takes to author a change, the bottleneck moves downstream. Testing and deploying safely to production is already one of the loudest customer asks and one of the sharpest pain points on the platform. When changes originate from agents as well as people, and arrive at a much higher rate, the ability to validate and trust them quickly stops being a quality-of-life improvement and becomes a precondition for platform growth. You will lead the team that enables this for developers.

This is not four adjacent feature areas with a shared manager. Customers experience the SDLC as one motion, and the central product challenge of this role is the connective tissue: a sandbox that behaves like the instance you will deploy to, a test suite that knows what changed, a release path that carries the evidence, and a model for building directly in production that an admin can actually govern. You set the strategy that makes their roadmaps resolve into a single lifecycle rather than four products that ship past each other.

The scope is deeply technical and close to execution. The Developer Reach feature area alone unlocks a path to building in production that admins can manage at scale without losing control, and it demands real technical depth to steer. You will also carry a broad surface, over twenty product areas, with the escalation volume that comes with it, and you will need to run that operational load without letting it consume the strategic work.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap across Developer Reach, Developer Sandboxes, Agentic Testing, and Release Ops, and define how they compose into one lifecycle from authored change to governed, audited deployment.
* Build, lead, and develop a team of PMs, one per area. Set a clear standard for product craft, coach PMs on strategy and execution, and hold the bar on the seams between them: shared primitives, consistent models, and a single coherent customer narrative.
* Set product direction for validating AI-originated change at scale: what it means to trust an agent's output, what evidence a release needs to carry, and how much of the test and review burden can be automated without losing accountability.
* Drive the Developer Reach strategy, including the product model for building in production with admin control, guardrails, and reversibility at enterprise scale.
* Define the sandbox strategy: provisioning speed, production parity, data handling, and the developer experience of getting a safe place to work in seconds rather than days.
* Own the release governance path end to end, including the tradeoffs between developer velocity and auditability, and the gating model that makes those tradeoffs explicit rather than accidental.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.desc:
Courier Health is on a mission to solve one of the biggest and most meaningful opportunities in healthcare: reinvent how people living with chronic and rare diseases are supported.

We are building the future of patient engagement for life sciences companies. Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes.

### **Come Build with Us**

We're a NYC-based team that believes culture, craft, and customer obsession go hand in hand. We show up for each other the same way we show up for the people we serve. We're an office-first company that values in-person collaboration 4 days per week because we believe the best work happens when you can collaborate and brainstorm together in the same room. If that sounds like your kind of place, we think you'll love it here.

### **The Opportunity**

Courier Health is at an inflection point. We exist to get patients faster, better access to life-saving therapies, and product helps to shape decisions related to which patients we reach next and how soon.

As Director of Product, you will lead a team of product managers covering the full platform, reporting directly to the CEO. You will also keep a hand in the work running discovery, writing the spec, making the call — on the bets that matter most.

The roadmap here is not handed down. You will decide what we build, in what order, and what we deliberately don't do, in a market where the right answer is rarely obvious and the stakes are patients starting therapy. If you have led product teams inside someone else's operating model and want to define your own, this is the seat.

### **What You'll Build**

**A product team that makes its own calls.** You will coach to a standard in weekly one on ones and roadmap reviews, raise the bar on writing and discovery, and give your PMs enough room to be wrong and get better. The goal is a team that can size a bet and defend it without you in the room.

**A roadmap the whole company can bet on.** Sales, implementation, and engineering all plan against what product says is coming. You will set the sequencing across a growing customer base, make the tradeoffs between what one strategic client needs and what the platform needs, and say no clearly enough that people trust the yes. Commitments hold, and when they change, everyone knows why in time to act.

**Discovery grounded in how patients actually get to therapy.** Our users are the people running patient support programs, field teams, and hub operations. You will get your team in front of them, translate what you hear into product, and build the customer and market fluency that makes our roadmap hard to copy. Strong opinions are welcome here. Strong opinions without customer contact are not.

### **What Makes You Successful**

* 10+ years in product management at a B2B software company, with a track record of shipping products enterprise customers renewed and expanded.
* 5+ years managing product managers. You have hired, coached, and given hard feedback that made someone better.
* Proven ownership of a roadmap end to end from customer discovery and strategy through launch and measured outcomes, not just execution against someone else's plan.
* Strong technical fluency. You can work through data models, API integrations, and architectural tradeoffs with engineers and hold your own. Coding is not required. Depth is.
* Excellent judgment under ambiguity. You can make a call with incomplete information, explain the reasoning, and change course without drama when the evidence shifts.
* Exceptional written communication. You think in documents, and your specs make the decision obvious.
* Comfortable working directly with senior customer stakeholders, including the conversations nobody wants to have.
* Experience building process where none existed, and the restraint to keep it minimal.

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Worked in healt

### **ABOUT OUR COMPANY:**

The crushing weight of debt is something that we believe holds people back from reaching their dreams and making a splash in the world. So in 2013, after seeing our friends and family struggle with student loans, we created Splash Financial.

Over the years, our mission has expanded to include helping people with other forms of debt - such as refinancing credit cards, which are at all time highs in the US. And we've been able to refinance $6+ Billion in loans through our network of Splash, powered credit union and bank partners who leverage our marketplace and automated loan processing technology. And we've raised over $135 million from investors like partners of DST Global, Citi Ventures, TruStage Ventures, Northwestern Mutual Future Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners, and more.

But at our core, we're still that little company from Cleveland with a big dream: to make people more powerful than their debt and we're just getting started..

### **ABOUT OUR WORKPLACE:**

Splash is remote-first, and proud of it — though our collections team works in-person at our Arizona location.

We spend our days simplifying financial products and getting them into the hands of people who need them most. Right now, we're focused on building financial technologies that fundamentally transform how the industry lends.

Although Splash has been around since 2013, we still operate like a startup — fast-paced, nimble, and full of heart. We're good people who care deeply about doing meaningful work and we approach challenges with creativity, passion, and urgency.

And to hire the best, we provide the best: great health insurance, competitive salaries, and unique benefits like quarterly meet-ups and access to engagement tools that keep us connected — even from afar.

At Splash, everything we do is guided by our values:

**Own It** – We take full accountability and follow through on commitments.

**Raise the Bar** – We move fast, innovate faster, and push through barriers.

**Say the Hard Thing** – We speak up with honesty, respect, and a desire to solve problems and make things better.

**Elevate Each Other** – We win as a team by lifting each other up.

These values show up in how we work and how we connect — whether we're collaborating on big projects or bonding over everyday moments. Yes, we even have Slack channels for #kids-and-pets and #food because we believe being human makes us better teammates.

**At Obie, we don’t just insure properties — we ensure progress.** With advanced technology, real-time data, and a vast network of agents and partners, we help real estate investors and landlords get insurance coverage whenever and wherever they need it. Thousands of owners nationwide trust us to be the insurance experts, so they don’t have to be.

Joining our team means embracing a fast-moving environment driven by innovation, collaboration, and constant progress. We learn quickly, iterate often, and celebrate wins together. If you're passionate about driving change and eager to impact the real estate and insurance market, Obie is the place for you.

Our Chicago based employees are hybrid, and expected to be in office on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

**Brief Summary of Role**

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Product Manager who loves figuring out how things work and can’t wait to make them better. You’ll join our growing team as an individual contributor, turning messy, technically complex problems into solutions and products that people actually use - and checking that they made a difference! You don’t need prior insurance experience; curiosity, ownership, and strong product judgement matter most.

You’ll own a meaningful product area end-to-end: bring your own point of view, get clear on why it matters to customers and the business, and build it with Design and Engineering. You enjoy turning “could we…?” into a working first version. You’ll think across customers, agents, internal teams, and interconnected systems. jobs.desc:
Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a Product Manager to help unify and scale our agentic AI platform, the shared foundation that grounds every solution built on it in two decades of accumulated retail expertise. The near-term work is getting the platform's first capabilities launched and consolidating what exists today onto a common core across intelligence and knowledge services, the developer platform, and the fleet of agents that runs on both. It serves teams across Toshiba and the customers and partners who build on it.

This is a build-and-ship role: writing specs, working alongside engineering to get capability out, putting it in front of the teams who use it, and bringing back what you learn. You will work closely with platform and engineering leadership on direction, own turning it into well-defined, shipped work, and supply the evidence from real use that shapes what comes next.

**What Success Looks Like**

Toshiba's twenty years of retail expertise lives in its products, its architecture, and the judgment behind both. The platform brings that together in one place and puts it to work for anyone who needs it, whether they are building something, answering a question, or delivering for a customer.

Success is how far that reaches: engineers shipping faster, expertise available without waiting on the expert, people doing work that used to need a specialist, and customers and partners building on the same foundation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the shared platform backlog across intelligence and knowledge services, the developer platform, and the agent fleet.

* Operate with a builder mindset: use the platform yourself, prototype what you are asking for, and drive adoption directly with the teams rather than only through documentation.

* Close the loop: gather feedback and usage signals from the teams on the platform, turn friction into concrete backlog items, and bring the evidence that informs the roadmap.

* Build the instrumentation and reporting behind the platform's KPIs, so progress is visible to the teams and to leadership: adoption and breadth of use across teams, onboarding time, the share of portal usage that reaches merged and deployed code, developer experience, agent and retrieval quality, and usage cost and attribution.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree with 10+ years of experience, or equivalent combination.

* Working familiarity with agentic AI concepts (tool use, retrieval/RAG, multi-agent orchestration, agent evaluation) and genuine interest in building deeper hands-on fluency.

In this role, you'll help build and deliver features that support real flight operations, in an industry that is rapidly modernizing, including a growing use of AI.  
  
The ideal candidate takes ownership of problems until they're genuinely resolved, not just flagged, and is curious by nature — verifying assumptions and raising concerns before small issues compound.
