jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Job Title:** Technical Product Manager

**Location:** Remote

**Company:** BrandRank.AI

**Duration:** Full Time

**Reports to:** Chief Product/Operations Officer

**About BrandRank.AI**

BrandRank.AI is an AI brand intelligence platform. We measure how AI answer engines such as Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Perplexity, Grok and Meta AI describe, rank and recommend brands, and we show brands where they are visible, where they are vulnerable, and what to fix first. Our customers include some of the largest consumer brands in the world. We are a small but growing team engaged in exciting work on a new frontier of brand building.

**The Role**

You will report to the Chief Product/Operations Officer and sit alongside the engineering team. You will translate the voice of the customer into product requirements and turn those requirements into working application solutions. You will own the connective tissue between what we build and what the rest of the company says about it, communicating product capabilities to the Sales team, the Marketing team and the customer in plain language. This is a hands-on role at an early-stage company. You will write the spec and help the engineers work through trade-offs to reach product-market fit.

**What You Will Do**

* **Partner with engineering.** Act as the day-to-day product counterpart to our engineering leads. Define requirements, scope features, write Linear specs, and keep the backlog honest.
* **Own product communications.** Write release notes, platform change documentation, and internal product updates. Set the cadence and keep it.
* **Run the roadmap.** Maintain the product roadmap with engineering. Translate technical initiatives such as data-pipeline changes, answer-engine coverage expansion and scoring-method updates into roadmap items with clear customer value.
* **Translate for the business.** Explain metric definitions, scoring logic and platform behavior to Sales, Customer Success and Marketing in plain language. Make sure what we tell customers matches what the product does.
* **Close the feedback loop.** Collect product feedback from the team and customers, track what is and is not on the roadmap, and report back on where each item stands.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3+ years of product management experience on technical products: APIs, data platforms, AI/ML products or core infrastructure.
* **A technical foundation.** A degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. You can read a schema, follow a pipeline diagram and ask engineers good questions.
* **Fluency with LLMs.** Hands-on experience with LLM-based products, including how they are prompted, evaluated and integrated into applications.
* **Strong technical writing.** You have a track record of release notes, documentation and internal updates that people actually read.
* **Fluency in agile delivery and modern engineering workflows.** Linear or Jira, sprints, and working directly with engineers every day.
* **Comfort with ambiguity and small-team pace.** You would rather own the outcome than wait for a process.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with search, or ranking and scoring systems.
* Experience working with large consumer brands or enterprise customers.
* Exposure to AI answer engines and how they source, cite and rank content.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Innovative Environment:** Be part of a cutting-edge startup that is revolutionizing brand strategy through AI-driven insights.
* **High-Impact Ownership:** Work directly with engineering and company leadership, with meaningful responsibility for how the product is defined, prioritized and communicated.
* **Small-Team Pace:** Join an early-stage environment where decisions move quickly, ownership is visible and everyone contributes to shipping.
* **Customer Proximity:** Work on product decisions that directly affect leading consumer brands and enterprise customers.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Education:

* Bache

jobs.desc:
At Shutterfly, we make life’s experiences unforgettable. We believe there is extraordinary power in the self-expression. That’s why our family of brands helps customers create products and capture moments that reflect who they uniquely are.

**Shutterfly is looking to hire a Product Manager to join their team!**

**What You'll Do Here:**

* Ability to continuously manage and groom feature/product backlogs with the goal of prioritizing the most important work. This requires collaboration across the organization to populate the backlog, understand what is feasible from an engineering perspective, and provide adequate information to help inform execution planning. Key expectations of backlog grooming include the ability to generate a business case estimate benefit/value, understand strategic alignment and work closely with the project management organization to estimate effort.
* Drive upstream project deliverables associated with a given project including business cases, project proposals, user requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* During execution, it is expected that you effectively identify and resolve risks, tradeoffs and obstacles, and understand when to engage leadership teams for support.
* Challenge the organization to be quality focused by leveraging data to help drive decisions, having a mindset focused on continuous process improvement and helping to guide test plans to ensure end-to-end, robust coverage.
* Collaboratively work with stakeholders across the organization to gather input and assist product leaders with multi-year product roadmaps.

**The Skills You'll Bring:**

* 5+ years of product management experience
* Demonstrated knowledge and ability to manage product backlogs
* 3+ years of experience leading project teams
* Experience managing a platform roadmap
* Demonstrated experience and knowledge working with Atlassian tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and BitBucket
* History and experience juggling multiple concurrent projects
* Experience working with agile scrum teams to bring new features to market
* Analytical and problem solving experience with large scale systems
* Strong partnership and collaboration skills – you appreciate the importance of bringing others along on the journey
* Experience managing teams through change

jobs.title: Product Manager, Billing & Collections
jobs.desc:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**Product Manager, Billing & Collections**

**ABC Fitness · Product · Remote-first**

**Billing and collections sit at the center of gym operators' revenue, retention, and customer trust.** This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for billing, subscriptions, payments, and collections across ABC Fitness, turning complex payment workflows into reliable, intelligent experiences for operators and their members.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the long-term vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for Billing & Collections; make clear trade-offs across customer value, revenue, risk, and engineering complexity.
* Build deep customer and market understanding, using operator feedback, competitive insight, and product data to identify the highest-impact problems and opportunities.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Customer Success, and GTM to shape and launch reliable billing experiences.
* Drive improvements across subscriptions, recurring payments, invoicing, dunning, notifications, payment recovery, and automation - including AI where it can materially improve outcomes.
* Define the product metrics that matter, use experimentation and analytics to guide decisions, and measure impact on payment success, involuntary churn, recovery, adoption, and cost efficiency.

**Who you are:**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products from strategy through launch.
* Experience in payments, billing, fintech, SaaS subscriptions, commerce, or a closely related domain.
* Strong customer empathy, business judgment, and analytical skills; you turn ambiguous problems into clear product bets and measurable outcomes.
* An effective cross-functional leader who can align technical and non-technical stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and maintain momentum through complexity.
* An excellent communicator who writes clearly, frames trade-offs precisely, and can influence executives, engineers, and customer-facing teams.
* **Especially valuable:** Hands-on experience with subscription billing, dunning or payment recovery, payment routing, risk/fraud, API-based platforms, or data/AI-powered product capabilities.

**How we measure success:**

* Billing-related involuntary churn decreases and payment recovery improves.
* Customers see more reliable, intuitive billing and collections experiences, reflected in product adoption and customer feedback.
* Roadmap investments produce measurable revenue, efficiency, or risk-reduction outcomes.
* Products launch with clear success metrics and strong cross-functional execution.

**Why ABC Fitness:**

ABC Fitness is a global fitness management platform serving members in 100+ countries. Our Commerce platform supports significant payment volume for fitness businesses, giving this role meaningful scale and direct impact on operator revenue and member experiences.

*ABC Fitness is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.*

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Order Management and Renewals Systems
jobs.desc:
Every month, hundreds of thousands of orders and renewals flow through Book of the Month's in-house software systems, and we are seeking a Technical Product Manager to own two of the most mission-critical pieces of software at the business: our Order Management System and our Renewal Management System. These mission critical systems are purpose built by our in-house product and engineering teams to support our subscription service and deliver the best new books to our members every month.. This is an ideal role for a technical PM who is equally obsessed with how systems work and how customers experience them.

**What you'll do...**

*Order Management*

* Own our Order Management System (OMS), which manages the entire lifecycle of an order from the moment a member clicks Ship to the moment it is delivered to our members.
* Be responsible for measuring and optimizing our shipping SLAs, and managing the roadmap that gets us there over time.
* Work and coordinate with key stakeholders to ensure that all updates are scoped well and releases are coordinated with associated updates to SOPs.

*Renewals*

* Own the product management of our Renewal Management System, which stages and processes payments for members of our subscription service.
* Measure and improve involuntary churn through systemic improvements, such as coordinating schedules, evaluating new recurring billing products, and assessing different payment processors.
* Develop a roadmap with our finance and engineering teams to prioritize projects and monitoring systems to track renewals and disbursements.

*Monitoring & Reporting*

* Conceptualize and spec detailed reports that allow you to monitor these systems at a granular level, down to every individual member and order.
* Operate on the instinct that if you cannot measure it, you do not know it is happening correctly.

**About you...**

* 5+ years of experience in a product management role, ideally in transactional product management processing large volumes of orders. E-commerce or subscription experience is required; both is ideal.
* Bachelor's degree, likely in a technical discipline.
* Strong technical skills and deep experience working with engineers to spec technical systems.
* Excellent at communicating technical information to different audiences.
* A rare combination of technical depth and customer obsession: these systems directly shape how members experience our product, and you need a real sense for the customer experience you want, plus the ability to translate it into something engineering can build.
* Exceptionally high attention to detail. In a renewal system, five errors is a huge number of errors, and you care about getting it right down to the individual human.

Salary Range: $100,000 - $165,000

We combine deep financial services expertise with cutting-edge innovation to build scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and business performance.

The **Technical Product Manager** serves as a strategic connector across the organization, helping align business priorities, technology investments, operational objectives, and innovation initiatives.

This role is responsible for driving enterprise-wide initiatives, improving organizational alignment, maintaining architectural and process transparency, and supporting modernization efforts through strong documentation, governance, and execution practices. Enterprise Strategy & Program Leadership

* Lead and coordinate enterprise-wide strategic initiatives across Product, Technology, Operations, Data, and Innovation teams.

* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency.

* Technical Design Documents
* Process Flows
* Business Workflows

* Integration Specifications

* Enterprise Architecture Diagrams

* Integration Maps

* Process Models

* Ensure documentation remains aligned with evolving systems, integrations, AI solutions, and enterprise platforms.

Delivery Management & Execution

* Coordinate delivery efforts across Engineering, Data, Architecture, Security, Operations, and Business teams.
* Facilitate planning sessions, roadmap reviews, backlog refinement, release coordination, and execution tracking.

**About the company**

At Covera Health, we're on a mission to improve healthcare by making every diagnosis more accurate.

Every year, millions of patients receive imaging that shapes life changing medical decisions. Yet too often, important findings are missed, patients struggle to access high quality imaging, and the healthcare system treats radiology like a commodity instead of one of the most critical moments in a patient's care journey.

We're changing that.

Covera combines clinical expertise, advanced AI, and one of the industry's largest radiology quality datasets to help detect disease earlier, improve diagnostic accuracy, and give clinicians greater confidence in every decision they make. Better diagnoses lead to better treatment, fewer unnecessary procedures, lower healthcare costs, and, most importantly, better outcomes for patients.

In 2026, Covera and Medmo came together to create the first platform designed to support the entire radiology journey. From helping patients find and schedule high quality imaging, to coordinating care, to ensuring the accuracy of every diagnosis, we're building a connected experience that simply hasn't existed before.

Backed by Insight Partners, our platform supports nearly 6 million people across Fortune 10 and Fortune 100 employers, three of the five largest national health plans, and thousands of value based primary care physicians.

This is an exciting moment to join Covera. We're building technology that is helping detect serious conditions earlier, improving the quality of care for millions of patients, and redefining what healthcare can be. If you're excited by meaningful work, ambitious teammates, and the opportunity to help save lives through better healthcare, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.desc:
About Us

Our purpose is to increase economic opportunity and make better money. We’re doing that through two connected parts that together make up the Reserve project.

Economic Opportunity

UGLYCASH is a financial services app designed around the needs of people earning money on the internet: creators, remote workers, freelancers, and entrepreneurs whose banks weren’t built for how they earn.

We’re starting in Latin America. Over the last 22 months, UGLYCASH has reached $5M+ in revenue run rate and 32,000+ monthly active customers.

This is the side of the Reserve project you’ll be working on.

Better Money

What happens to that money after you earn it matters too.

Cash, money in a bank account, and payment stablecoins each work differently. We believe the money people use should do more than move from one place to another. It should also give people a better way to save and grow what they earn.

That’s why we’re continuing to improve the version of money UGLYCASH customers already use, with the long term goal of giving more people access to better options for their money.

Check us out:

Instagram

Youtube

X

**Description**

We're looking for someone early in their product career who has already found ways to make things happen.

You'll work directly with founders to explore and build new financial products. Our founders bring vision and hypotheses. You'll help turn them into products through customer understanding, evidence, experimentation, and execution.

We're hiring for the product owner you can become over the next 24 months, not the title you already have. You'll start with a focused opportunity, experienced people around you, and real responsibility. As your judgment grows, so will the size of the problems you own.

If you want to learn how new products go from an idea to something thousands of people actually use, this is the kind of seat that's hard to find.

What you could build

* Ways to earn, receive, and use money: Better payment collection, deposit experiences, and money movement for internet earners.
* Credit: New ways to make useful credit products available to more customers and markets.
* Activation and growth: Helping customers understand UGLYCASH's value and start using it.
* Products for specific customer groups: Building experiences for freelancers, online entrepreneurs, creators, and other communities with distinct financial needs.

These are examples of where the work could lead. Your first assignment will be a focused opportunity selected with the founders.

What you'll do

* Talk to customers, study their behavior, and figure out which problems are worth solving.
* Turn founder hypotheses into testable approaches and manageable first versions.
* Bring evidence that strengthens an idea or changes it.
* Use AI to research, analyze, prototype, and shorten the path from idea to useful learning.
* Work closely with engineering and design to take ideas from concept through launch.
* Measure what happens after something ships and use what you learn to make it better.
* Build the judgment to own increasingly ambitious product opportunities over time.

  
**Requirements**

You don't need a previous PM title or fintech resume.

We're looking for evidence of initiative, clear thinking, curiosity, and fast learning. Show us something you've built, improved, or taken responsibility for. It could come from a job, small business, coursework, personal project, or something you created independently.

You're curious about customers and the economics behind a product. You're comfortable with numbers, can explain your reasoning, respond to feedback, and know when to ask for help. Most importantly, you care whether an idea actually creates value for someone.

You've used AI to make something useful, whether that's a prototype, analysis, automation, tool, or other concrete result. You can explain your choices, identify mistakes, and improve the output.

***By joining the American Red Cross you will touch millions of lives every year and experience the greatness of the human spirit at its best. Are you ready to be part of the world's largest humanitarian network?***
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Join us—Where your Career is a Force for Good!**
==================================================

**Job Description:**

Joining The American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.

  

When you choose to be a force for good, you’ll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life’s work with an ongoing mission that’s bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.

  

Where Your Career is a Force for Good!

  

***WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (Job Overview):***

The Humanitarian Services Product Management team aspires to create human-centered digital experiences for our clients and workforce and to ensure our digital products support successful mission delivery. Our products support our humanitarian mission in many ways, including delivering financial assistance to those impacted by disasters, visualizing situational awareness for disaster response and logistics operations, and onboarding and assigning volunteers to critical mission roles.

  

**About Our Contact Center and Operations Platforms:**

This role supports a portfolio of 24x7 contact center platforms serving Disaster Relief, SAF Hero Care, and Fundraising operations. Built on AWS Amazon Connect and modern IVR technologies, these mission-critical systems help clients, donors, military families, volunteers, and responders access information, assistance, and support, especially during periods of crisis and large-scale disaster activity. The product portfolio integrates with numerous business systems and focuses on delivering compassionate, high-quality client experiences while driving operational efficiency, workforce productivity, and service excellence. The team is actively advancing automation, AI, intelligent routing, agent assist, and digital self-service capabilities to improve both client outcomes and operational performance.

**The Position:**

We are seeking a Product Manager to own and evolve our Contact Center platform — the technology and experience layer that powers workforce productivity, real-time operational insight, and AI-enabled service delivery across our contact center and chapter network. This role sits at the intersection of agent experience, customer/client experience, and AI innovation, and is responsible for ensuring that every call, chat, and interaction path is efficient, intelligent, and easy to navigate — for both the people answering and the people calling.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable diving into IVR call-flow logic and phone routing architecture as they define a roadmap for AI-assisted coaching, sentiment analysis, and generative summarization. This is a highly cross-functional role requiring close partnership with contact center operations, chapter/field offices, engineering, data science, and telephony vendors.
